summary.intent: Execute the /gsd-plan-phase workflow end-to-end for CipherBox roadmap phase 68.2 (SDK-owned read chain and resolved folder listings), including research, planning, and verification.
summary.outcome: Completed the validation and research-decision stages: confirmed no UI plan:pre gate blocks the phase, surfaced the research gate to the user via AskUserQuestion, and spawned the gsd-phase-researcher agent, which produced 68.2-RESEARCH.md. Planning and verification steps had not yet run by the end of the transcript.

repo: In CipherBox's GSD hook registry, a capability's 'when' condition can correctly leave zero active plan:pre hooks for a phase (e.g. UI) even though the corresponding lower-level check (ui-plan-gate) unconditionally reports block:true — the workflow (§5.6) only acts on the check result when a matching capability hook is actually active, so raw check output must be cross-referenced against activeHooks before treating it as a real gate.

Phase 68.2 config has research, plan_check, nyquist, and pattern_mapper all enabled with granularity=fine, and 6 active plan:pre hooks (intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate→planner, tdd→planner, drift gate non-blocking) — drift is non-blocking so it doesn't halt planning.
workflow: gsd plan-phase workflow's research decision gate (§5.1) triggers an explicit AskUserQuestion when a phase has CONTEXT.md but no RESEARCH.md and Nyquist validation is enabled (Nyquist needs a Validation Architecture section sourced from RESEARCH.md).
The gsd-phase-researcher subagent carries its own embedded instructions — the 'agent skills' extraction step returned empty, which is expected rather than an error.

Because RESEARCH.md feeds both Nyquist's VALIDATION.md and the planner downstream, the researcher was spawned synchronously (not backgrounded) to preserve the strictly sequential research→plan→verify flow.
UI spawn banners follow gsd's ui-brand.md convention: must include the literal phrase 'runs in a subagent' so users don't mistake a 1-5 min silent subagent run for a freeze.

friction: Determining whether the UI plan:pre gate actually applied required a second, lower-level inspection of the raw hooks JSON, since the higher-level check (block:true) alone was misleading without checking activeHooks.
open_items: Planning (gsd-planner spawn) and verification (gsd-plan-checker loop) for phase 68.2 had not yet been executed in this transcript — workflow was paused after research completed.
SHARE-WRITE-KEY gap (write-share key threading via collectChildKeys removal) remains open per prior project memory and may be relevant context for this phase's SDK read-chain work.
